Senses.PreferredTarget: whether there is profit or none, one does not leave the marketplace
SearchAliases: whether there is profit or none, one does not leave the marketplace
Senses.Note: The market proverb says that profit and loss alike remain within the arena of exchange.

Senses.Explanation: Whether profitable or not, one does not leave the marketplace treats engagement itself as unavoidable. Zhenjing speaks it at Mazu's tower and twice applies it to Bajiao's staff case; Donglin and Jieshi preserve further named uses of the market image.
